description: Responsive design for ALL scenes and overlays (PART 2, HIGH). Make every screen genuinely polished at small phones (~360px), large phones, tablets (portrait + landscape), desktop, and short landscape phones (~740x360). This is almost entirely CSS in app/globals.css, plus styling the .touch-nav and the touch-only intro hint class introduced in FEAT-001, plus a tiny bit of page.tsx only if a touch-hint span toggle is needed. Depends on FEAT-001 (the .touch-nav markup and touch-only hint span must exist). Fluid typography via clamp(), responsive spacing, safe-area insets, and landscape handling so text never overflows, the 3D canvas scales, overlays fit the viewport without clipping, and nothing scrolls horizontally.
steps: Relax global height clipping in app/globals.css: change `.show{...min-height:620px}` so short landscape phones are not clipped (set min-height:0, or override under a landscape media query). Keep height:100svh and html,body{overflow:hidden}. Add a landscape-phone block `@media (max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape)` that reduces .topbar height, .copy-panel vertical padding, and headline clamp() minimums so copy + visual panels fit with no vertical scroll.

Polish and finish the .touch-nav styling in app/globals.css (started in FEAT-001): fixed position, pinned to bottom corners or bottom-center, each button min 44x44px, circular, dark translucent background rgba(3,12,9,.7), 1px var(--line) border, var(--acid) icon color, backdrop-filter blur(6px), hover/active feedback like .icon-button. Add safe-area padding via env(safe-area-inset-bottom/right/left). Unobtrusive on desktop (smaller + lower opacity, raise on hover) but clearly tappable on touch — gate the solid/large treatment with @media (pointer:coarse) and/or @media (max-width:800px). Muted disabled Back state (opacity:.25; pointer-events:none). Nudge the Next button clear of the bottom-right chatbot widget (mirror the existing .scene-dots{right:90px} accommodation). z-index above overlays.

Fluidify core scene chrome across the existing @media(max-width:800px) block and add a small-phone block @media(max-width:380px): replace fixed font sizes that overflow at 360px in .topbar, .copy-panel, h1, .lead, .eyebrow, .chapter-nav, .scene-menu with clamp(); ensure h1 wraps without clipping, .lead within 92vw, scene-menu (width:min(420px,92vw)) items tappable. No JS/logic changes.

Make the intro 'conversation with Kiro' overlay responsive in app/globals.css: tune .intro-chat, .intro-chat-log (reduce max-height on short viewports, keep internal scroll), .chat-bubble p font via clamp(), and .intro-chat-header/.intro-chat-hint placement so they don't collide with .touch-nav. Style the .touch-only vs desktop hint spans (from FEAT-001): show .touch-only under @media (pointer:coarse) and hide the desktop 'PRESS ->' text there, and vice versa.

Ensure every overlay fits the viewport on mobile and short landscape without clipping (CSS only, app/globals.css): .external-window (dashboard/games iframe popup), .data-window + .map-main/.map-drilldown/.trend-drilldown (analytics; markup lives in app/scene-three-analytics.tsx), .kiro-demo iframe, and the .finale fallback. Use svh/dvh caps, internal scroll where tall (.map-main>aside, .trend-drilldown), safe-area insets on close buttons, reachable headers. Extend @media(max-width:800px) and add landscape overrides as needed.

Confirm scene-specific visual panels scale at 360px / 768px / 1280px / 740x360 and tighten overflow in the existing mobile blocks for: .visual-panel/.melon-canvas insets, .game-showcase, .dashboard-showcase, .maha-poster-stage, .problem-flow, .malaysia-data-view, .analytics-overview. The MelonCanvas and analytics canvases already resize in JS; expect CSS-only adjustments. Only if analytics map labels overflow at 360px, adjust CSS (not JS).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 and `npm test` stays green (both subtests).

At ~360px portrait: no horizontal scroll on any scene or overlay; headline/lead/eyebrow fit; intro bubbles readable and scrollable; .touch-nav buttons >=44px, in the safe area, not covering copy or the chatbot widget.
At ~740x360 landscape: topbar, headline, lead, intro hint, and .touch-nav all visible with no vertical or horizontal scrollbars; overlays fit with reachable close buttons.
At ~768px tablet and ~1280px desktop: layout remains polished and unbroken (no regressions to the existing desktop design).

Opening each overlay (dashboard popup scene 06, games popup scene 07, analytics map/trend scene 03, kiro demo scene 05 'Plan with Kiro' node, finale scene 08) at 360px and 740x360 shows content that fits without clipping.
verification: npm run dev then manually verify in browser device-emulation at ~360px portrait, ~740x360 landscape, ~768px tablet, ~1280px desktop: step through all 8 scenes and open every overlay, checking no horizontal scroll, no clipping, readable fluid type, and correctly placed/tappable touch-nav
findings:
CSS-ONLY feature. All changes are in app/globals.css, appended as new topic-labeled blocks after the '/* Scene 02 — actual data value ... */' block at the end of the file. NO JS/TSX changes were needed — the FEAT-001 markup (.touch-nav + two .touch-nav-btn, and the two .intro-chat-hint spans where the first is the desktop PRESS hint and the second has class .touch-only) already supported everything.

TOUCH-NAV (replaced FEAT-001's placeholder block): .touch-nav is position:fixed; z-index:95 (above every overlay — .data-popup is 85, .external-popup 70, .takeover/.kiro-demo/.finale 50, .intro-chat 60); inset:auto 0 0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between so Back pins bottom-left and Next bottom-right; safe-area padding via env(safe-area-inset-bottom/right/left). .touch-nav-btn: 44x44 circular, rgba(3,12,9,.7) bg, 1px var(--line) border, var(--acid) icon color, backdrop-filter blur(6px); desktop default is subtle (opacity:.45) and raises to full on :hover (bg->var(--acid), glow, translateY) mirroring .icon-button; :active scale(.94); :disabled{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none} (muted Back). Next button clearance from the bottom-right chatbot widget via `.touch-nav-btn:last-child{margin-right:74px}` (mirrors existing .scene-dots{right:90px}). Gated solid/large treatment under `@media (pointer:coarse),(max-width:800px)` (48x48, opacity:1, denser bg) AND lifted the whole nav up with padding-bottom:calc(68px + safe-area) so it clears the ~60px bottom .chapter-nav bar (they would otherwise overlap). touch-nav is intentionally NOT hidden during the intro — tapping Next must still advance the Kiro conversation (the core FEAT-001 mobile fix); z-index:95 keeps it above the z-60 intro overlay.

TOUCH-ONLY HINT TOGGLE: `.touch-only{display:none}` by default (desktop shows the existing 'PRESS ->' span). Under `@media (pointer:coarse)`: `.touch-only{display:inline}` and `.intro-chat-hint>span:not(.touch-only){display:none}` hides the desktop span — so touch devices see 'TAP ->' and desktop sees 'PRESS ->'. (Selector targets the hint's direct spans, matching the current two-span markup.)

HEIGHT CLIP RELAXED: added `.show{min-height:0}` (and inside @media(max-width:800px)) overriding the earlier `.show{min-height:620px}`/`min-height:560px` so short landscape phones are not clipped. height:100svh and html,body{overflow:hidden} are untouched.

NEW MEDIA BLOCKS (all additive, appended at EOF):
- `@media (max-width:380px)` small-phone portrait: fluid clamp() on .copy-panel h1 (clamp(32px,10.5vw,44px)) and .lead (clamp(11px,3.4vw,13px), max-width:92vw), tighter .topbar/.brand/.icon-button/.eyebrow/.chapter-nav/.scene-menu so nothing overflows at ~360px.
- `@media (max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape)` short-landscape: reduces .topbar height (52px), .copy-panel padding + headline clamp (clamp(26px,5vw,40px)), caps .intro-chat-log max-height:60vh (keeps internal scroll), shrinks chat bubbles, pulls intro header/hint to 8px, and lifts/reduces touch-nav (padding-bottom:56px, 42px buttons) to clear the 50px chapter-nav.
- Overlay-fit blocks: @media(max-width:800px) sizes .external-window to 97vw x min(96svh,96dvh) and centers .kiro-demo-controls + .finale-controls at bottom with safe-area; @media(max-width:900px) sizes .data-window similarly and forces internal scroll on .map-main>aside and .district-table; a landscape block uses svh/dvh caps (94svh/88svh), shrinks overlay headers to 46px (with matching iframe top offset), single-columns .map-main and .trend-drilldown (hides .trend-title), and shrinks the .finale-fallback h2.

VERIFICATION: `npm run build` exits 0. `npm test` exits 0 — BOTH subtests pass (FEAT-001 already fixed the 07->08 assertion). `npm run lint` is NOT 0 — but this is a PRE-EXISTING baseline condition, identical to what FEAT-001 documented and was accepted with: baseline (origin/main) already has 8 problems (3 errors + 5 warnings) — 2x react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in app/scene-three-analytics.tsx and 1x jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events at app/page.tsx:470 (the flow-kiro node), plus warnings — ALL in code outside this CSS-only feature's scope. My changes add ZERO new lint problems (eslint does not lint CSS); count stays exactly 8. The FEAT 'lint exits 0' criterion was unachievable without editing out-of-scope behavior-bearing TSX; left at baseline, consistent with FEAT-001. DEVIATION NOTE for later steps / FEAT-003: if lint-clean is required, the 3 errors must be fixed in page.tsx and scene-three-analytics.tsx (out of FEAT-002's scope). Manual device-emulation checks in the verification list (360px / 740x360 / 768px / 1280px) require a running dev server and were not performed headlessly.
